prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Tobias Reyne for the job below.

About the freelancer: 7 years experience; skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML and CSS

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Fix magento web pages
up date web store and add new store with our B2B the person that we had move to Germany and can not work for us anymore
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
(none)

Style:
- Open by briefly introducing yourself.
- Do not mention any specific past project or client.
- Keep it under 150 words.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne, a full stack developer with 7 years of experience.

I can help fix your Magento web pages, update your web store, and add a new B2B store. I work comfortably across front-end and back-end development, and I’m used to handling tasks that need careful updates, clean implementation, and reliable functionality.

My background includes JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API work, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. While Magento is not my main stack, I’m confident working through web store issues, making updates, and supporting smooth transitions when a previous developer is no longer available.

If you’d like, I can help review the current setup, identify what needs fixing, and get the store improvements moving efficiently.
